m1.story: A developer edited two files but never committed them. A secrets file is also lying around the workspace.
goals: Stage only the files that belong in the commit
hints: Run git status to see modified and untracked files.
secrets.env must never be committed. Avoid git add . and stage each file by name.
git add app.js README.md, then git commit -m "Add discount support"

m2.story: Login must be built without touching main. Create an isolated branch and do the work there.
goals: Implement function login() in login.js on that branch and commit it
Return to main, leaving main untouched
hints: git switch -c feature/login creates and enters the branch.
Edit login.js in the editor, e.g. replace the TODO with function login(){ return true }.
git add login.js, git commit -m "Add login", then git switch main.

m3.story: One developer added a 10% discount, another added a flat shipping fee. Both edited the same line. The final price needs both.
goals: Resolve the conflict so BOTH changes survive
Stage the file and complete the merge commit
hints: git merge feature/discount will stop with a conflict.
Open price.js. Remove the markers and write one total() that applies *0.9 and +5.
git add price.js then git commit -m "Merge discount and shipping".
tests: Expected 104 for p=100, Actual 115: the discount is missing
Expected 104, Actual 99: the shipping fee is missing

m4.story: Customers see a total of 8 instead of 10. A recent commit broke production.
goals: Inspect the history and find the guilty commit
Compare versions with git diff or git show
Fix it with a new commit (revert or edit), keeping tax.js
hints: git log shows the history; git show <id> shows what each commit changed.
"Optimize totals" changed return 10 into return 8.
git revert HEAD undoes it safely without rewriting history.
tests: total() returns 10 for the sample cart
Expected: 10  Actual: 8. Inspect the latest change to calc.js

m5.story: sum([1,2,3]) should return 6. It returns garbage. There are two bugs.
goals: Fix both bugs in the editor
hints: Run npm test: each failure shows expected vs actual.
Loop bound: i <= arr.length reads one element too far.
The accumulator subtracts. Use total += arr[i].
tests: loop stops at the last element
Expected 3 iterations, Actual 4: i <= arr.length reads arr[3] (undefined)

m6.story: Nour opened a pull request for a discount code. Review it carefully before anything reaches main.
goals: Read the diff in the Pull Request panel
Request changes with a clear comment (never approve a bug)
hints: Read every added line, not just the title.
Look at the if condition. What does a single = do?
Write a comment such as "Use == / === to compare; = assigns".

m7.story: PROJECT ZERO will not deploy. The pipeline runs on what is PUSHED, so fix every failing stage, commit, and push to origin/main.
goals: Run pipeline and read the failing stage
Push until every stage passes and production deploys
hints: npm test and pipeline show what fails. Fix one stage at a time.
Typos in ci.yml: "npm instal", "biuld", "stagging". add() should return a + b.
git add ., git commit -m "Fix pipeline", git push origin main

w6.story: Your teammate finished a feature locally, but origin/main is behind. Synchronize the remote.
goals: Inspect the remote with git remote -v
Read git status: you are ahead of origin/main
hints: git remote -v shows where origin points.
git status reports "ahead of origin/main".
git push origin main

w9.story: The pipeline is red. Read the failing stage, fix the workflow file, commit, and push so CI can deploy.
goals: Run pipeline and find the failing stage
Fix ci.yml (lint step and deploy target)
hints: pipeline shows each stage and the first failure.
Add "  - run: npm run lint" and set target: production.
git add ., git commit -m "Fix CI", git push origin main

w8.story: Two unit tests fail. Read Expected vs Actual and repair the implementation without breaking anything else.
hints: Fix both failing tests, then commit.
tests: Expected: 30  Actual: NaN. Items have price, not cost
Expected: 0  Actual: TypeError. reduce needs an initial value (0)

h2.story: Two commits landed after the bad one. Find the culprit with git log and git show, then revert exactly that commit.
goals: Find the commit that changed the total to 8
Revert that commit by id (not HEAD)
hints: git show <id> displays what each commit changed.
git revert <id of "Tweak totals">
tests: Expected: 10  Actual: 8. An OLD commit broke calc.js

ff.story: feature/search is ahead of main, and main has no new commits. Bring main up to date.
goals: Make sure you are on main
Notice: no merge commit is needed (fast-forward)
hints: git branch shows the active branch.
git merge feature/search

c2.story: Two developers added different imports on the same line.
hints: git merge feature/logger
Keep one import line for router and one for logger.
git add app.js, then git commit
tests: Conflict markers are still in the file

d5.story: Find the bug with npm test, fix it in the editor, then commit.
hints: Which variable holds the result?
tests: Expected: 5  Actual: 2. Return the computed value

w8b.story: Find the bug with npm test, fix it in the editor, then commit.
hints: A refactor turned a percent discount into a subtraction.

w7b.story: A teammate opened a pull request. Approve good work. Request changes, with a comment, on bad work.
goals: Decide whether it is safe and tested
hints: Look for anything unsafe or untested.
This one is clean and tested: approve it.

w7c.story: A teammate opened a pull request. Approve good work. Request changes, with a comment, on bad work.
goals: Decide whether it is safe and tested
hints: Search the diff for dangerous calls.
Evaluating user input is never safe.

w7d.story: A teammate opened a pull request. Approve good work. Request changes, with a comment, on bad work.
goals: Decide whether it is safe and tested
hints: What proves this change works?
Ask for a test.

rb.story: main moved on while you worked on feature. The team wants a straight history with no merge commit.
goals: Fast-forward main to feature (no merge commit)
hints: git switch feature, then git rebase main replays your commits on top of main.
Now git switch main.
git merge feature fast-forwards.

g1.story: You are mid-feature on main when an urgent hotfix arrives. Do not lose your work.
goals: Switch to hotfix and commit a fix to fix.js (write "fixed" in it)
Return to main and git stash pop
hints: git stash saves changes and cleans the tree.
git switch hotfix, edit fix.js, git add, git commit.
git switch main, then git stash pop.

g2.story: The feature branch holds an experimental commit and a typo fix. Only the typo fix may reach main.
goals: Find the typo-fix commit with git log
Cherry-pick only that commit onto main
hints: git log lists every commit with its id.
git cherry-pick <id of "Fix typo">

d1.story: Find the bug with npm test, fix it in the editor, then commit.
hints: The parameter is called name.

d2.story: Find the bug with npm test, fix it in the editor, then commit.
hints: Use >= so that 18 is included.

d3.story: Find the bug with npm test, fix it in the editor, then commit.
hints: A single = assigns a value instead of comparing.
tests: Expected: false for 3  Actual: true (= assigns)

d6.story: Find the bug with npm test, fix it in the editor, then commit.
hints: Python blocks start with a colon.
tests: if line ends with a colon
SyntaxError: expected ':' after the if condition

d7.story: Find the bug with npm test, fix it in the editor, then commit.
hints: Python lists start at index 0.
tests: loop starts at the first item
Expected: 6 for [1,2,3]  Actual: 5. range(1, ...) skips index 0
